hypothesis: Explicit entry conditions and controller feedback let characters recover from interrupted journeys and failed proposals, enabling continued provisioning after the initial shelter project.
evaluation: Compare unchanged social-m1-12 with recovery-m1-13 using the same four characters and resources. Track use of when, journey arrivals, plan parse errors followed by successful new proposals, model calls diverted for failed execution, food transfers/deposits and beneficiaries, accepted evidence-grounded learning, deaths and provider failures. Reject engine/authority regressions. Require sustained social effects and a fresh repeat before declaring the society milestone.
